definitions.gloss: to tidy up; to put in order; to arrange neatly
definitions.explanation: To organize and arrange things so they are neat and orderly. Focuses on arranging items in their proper places rather than cleaning dirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整頓|せいとん}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's tidy up the room before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ジャンル→ジャンル：11017_janru⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{整頓|せいとん}した。
examples.english: I organized the books on the shelf by genre.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{整頓|せいとん}→整頓：07617_seiton⟧, meaning to arrange things neatly in their proper places. Almost always appears paired with ⟦{整理|せいり}→整理：03297_seiri⟧ in the set phrase ⟦{整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん}→整理整頓：08423_seiriseiton⟧, which is ubiquitous in Japanese schools, workplaces, and homes.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the thing being tidied.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{整理|せいり}{整頓|せいとん}→整理整頓：08423_seiriseiton⟧ — tidying and organizing (a set phrase)
- ⟦{身|み}の{回|まわ}り→身の回り：07854_minomawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整頓|せいとん}する — to tidy up one's personal space
- {整頓|せいとん}された⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ — a well-organized room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧ — to organize, sort out (includes discarding unnecessary things)
- ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ — to tidy up, put away (more casual, everyday)
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to clean (focuses on removing dirt, not organizing)
